result.decisiveNextEvidence: The smallest reproducible falsifier that isolates the exact Harness-owned control/state interaction causing the misclassified correction event at the ToolBridge boundary — causal admission flips the authority model for everything downstream.
result.reason: H-NOTOOL is the strongest next frontier choice: it already has a bounded reproduction request from the owner, an exact causal event (misclassified correction at a ToolBridge boundary) that is empirically falsifiable read-only, and its resolution materially changes the Harness authority model — the highest-leverage node in this system. S-UNKNOWN is adjacent (same Harness owner, narrow adapter representation gap, patch path not yet closed) and would benefit immediately from the causal knowledge H-NOTOOL produces. R-WITNESS is high-value but requires a physical adversarial experiment that is slower to dispatch than H-NOTOOL's existing reproduction scaffold. H-DISCOVERY is efficient-later work that depends on the correctness of the control model established by H-NOTOOL. G-HUMAN is blocked by 0/11 responses and mechanical correctness cannot substitute — it should wait for human data, not budget. HOST-PKG's dependency-expansion observation (9→34) is a symptom already observed; mapping root cause is lower-marginal-value than the Harness causal explanation. F-LIVE involves real capital and consequence-bearing reconciliation; it is operationally risky to interleave as the next unit and is better deferred until the authority/control model is stabilized by H-NOTOOL.
